desc:
✨ Welcome to Would You Rather: Jujutsu Tower! ✨

Pick a door and build your cursed fashion fit one choice at a time 💖
Will you become the ultimate style sorcerer… or end up completely cursed? 💀

Every door gives you something new:
👗 outfits
💇 hair
✨ accessories
😈 or a disaster that RUINS your whole look...

Make it to the top of the tower and prove your drip is unmatched 💅

⭐ Like the game + join the group for special rewards & perks!
